profile.summary: A small company that supports schools and organizations in offering mental health services for students and families. It provides mental health program consultation, coaching for school counselors, social-emotional and small-group curriculum, and workshops and professional development.

sources.title: Where to Begin: Building Capacity for Reimagining School-Based Mental Health

review.notes: Exact distinctive name; Digital Promise article and healingaguas.com support the legal name, school mental-health consulting, counselor coaching, SEL/small-group curriculum and workshops, which fit OUSD's counseling services agreement; founder has Oakland school-counseling background. Antioch is unverified but headquarters/address are null, and the word 'small' in the summary is an unstated but minor inference.
